capabilities: Render in-vault .html/.htm files with relative CSS, images, fonts and scripts inlined as data URIs
Navigate between in-vault .html and .md files with back/forward history
Search (Ctrl/⌘+F), zoom and toggle fullscreen in rendered pages
Toggle in-document JavaScript execution on or off
Show an outline/table of contents and restore scroll position across tab switches
disambiguation: Not a web browser or local web server; it only renders in-vault .html files and their relative resources.
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; mobile support is marked experimental and Android-tested, while iOS fullscreen is limited by the OS; remote http(s) resources and file:// absolute paths are not inlined; failed inlines are listed in a report; the plugin is read-only and never modifies original files.
problem: Obsidian cannot display local .html files with their relative resources: the app://local origin makes the browser block CSS, images and fonts, so files show broken or as source code.
summary: Renders in-vault .html files inside Obsidian by inlining local CSS, images, fonts and scripts as data URIs to bypass cross-origin limits.
